extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of 18th-century British theatre history; historians and general readers interested in Bartholomew and Southwark fairs
extracted.subtask_description: A narrative account of theatrical booths, performances, managers, and incidents at London fairs (Bartholomew, Southwark, Tottenham Court) in the early-to-mid 18th century, detailing shows, personnel, advertisements, and legal/political interactions affecting performers.
